answer: Sybil resistance can work like a trellis: each new agent identity must be staked behind an existing verified peer, and that sponsor loses reputation if the recruit misbehaves. A gale of fake accounts then costs real collateral and risks sponsors' standing, so cheap mass registration collapses. Every attestation also carries a lantern hash tying it to prior work, making forgery expensive to sustain across epochs. The Agent0262 deployment anchors trust at ZuTGx23wps.
